cases.title: Fix the README quick-start wording
cases.description: The README quick-start section has a stale typo in the dev-server command. Correct the wording so the documented command matches the real `npm run dev` script, and fix the typo without touching anything else in the file.
acceptanceCriteria: The README quick-start section names the real `npm run dev` command
No file other than the README changes

cases.title: Tighten the empty-state copy on the shared task table
cases.description: The shared task-table component's empty-state label reads as a placeholder rather than finished copy. Rewrite the wording so it reads as a deliberate, isolated styling and copy touch-up, with no change to layout, data fetching, or any other component.
acceptanceCriteria: The empty-state label no longer reads as placeholder text
No component other than the shared task-table changes

cases.title: Guard buildEvaluationSummary against a campaign with zero recorded runs
cases.description: server/evaluation.mjs's buildEvaluationSummary assumes at least one recorded evaluation exists and throws on an empty campaign. Make it return a summary with zero counts instead of throwing when no evaluations have been recorded yet, and add a test in tests/evaluation.test.mjs covering that case.
acceptanceCriteria: buildEvaluationSummary returns a zero-count summary instead of throwing when no evaluations are recorded

cases.title: Preserve the executable bit when exporting a candidate patch
cases.description: server/campaign-export.mjs's exportCandidatePatch drops a changed file's executable permission bit in the generated unified diff. Preserve the permission-mode lines Git already emits so the exported patch applies with the original file mode intact, and extend tests/campaign-export.test.mjs to cover a candidate that changes a file's executable bit.
acceptanceCriteria: A candidate patch for a file whose executable bit changed preserves that mode change
tests/campaign-export.test.mjs covers a file whose executable bit changed

cases.title: Surface a supplied context manifest's truncation flag in the task inspector
cases.description: The task inspector's context-supplied panel already renders each context manifest entry but does not show whether an entry was truncated before the model saw it. Add a truncated flag to the manifest data server-side wherever it is not already present, and render a visible truncation indicator next to any truncated entry in the task inspector's context panel in src/. Keep the panel non-collapsible per the existing inspector convention.
acceptanceCriteria: A context manifest entry that was truncated carries a truncated flag from the server
The task inspector's context panel visibly marks a truncated entry without requiring a click to reveal it
An entry that was not truncated shows no truncation indicator

cases.title: Show which Grill decisions were accepted by policy rather than by a human
cases.description: When a task's Grill policy is auto-accept-recommendations, recorded decisions do not currently distinguish a policy acceptance from a human one anywhere in the UI. Extend the recorded decision shape server-side to carry who accepted it, and render a visible 'accepted by policy' label next to any such decision in the Grill history view in src/, leaving human-made decisions unlabeled as they are today.
acceptanceCriteria: A Grill decision accepted under auto-accept-recommendations records that it was accepted by policy
The Grill history view labels a policy-accepted decision as accepted by policy
A human-made decision renders exactly as it does today, with no new label
